description:
Monsoon Bike Ride Bangladesh | Heavy Rain Hill Road & Sea Side Ride🏍️🔥

In this adventure ride, we take the N160 and 300SR  on a massive long-distance highway test from Dhaka to Cox’s Bazar, passing through the stunning hill roads of Rangamati and Bandarban. This journey covers highways, hill tracts, and coastal roads and this is a true monsoon motorcycle road trip across Bangladesh.

This tour is even more special because we are riding two different bikes together: Bajaj Pulsar N160, and CFMOTO 300SR. 

Route Covered:
Dhaka → Rangamati → Bandarban → Cox’s Bazar

Highlights of this ride:
• 1550 KM long-distance motorcycle tour
• Highway cruising and overtaking tests
• Hill tract roads and scenic mountain routes
• Riding to Cox’s Bazar — the longest sea beach in the world

If you love motorcycle touring, road trips, and exploring Bangladesh on two wheels, this adventure ride is for you.

Don’t forget to Like, Comment, and Subscribe for more bike rides, touring videos, and motorcycle adventures in Bangladesh! 🏍️🌄🌊
